prompt: Fetch paginated Instagram media comments, identify comments needing replies, post reply ratings in bulk, and later clean up duplicate or mistaken replies.

results.use_case: Fetch paginated Instagram media comments, identify comments needing replies, post reply ratings in bulk, and later clean up duplicate or mistaken replies.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if connected account context/permissions are unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the active account using INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO (ensure comment read/write is available).
[Optional (if target media is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover recent media using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA (collect media identifiers; persist paging.cursors.after for older items).
[Optional (if selected media seems invalid/inaccessible)] [Prerequisite]: Validate the media object using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA (confirm it is accessible/published before comment operations).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve comments using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS (extract comment identifiers and text; treat items without parent_id as top-level).

[Optional (if the desired comment is not in the first page)] [Next Step]: Paginate using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS (advance with paging.cursors.after until exhausted or the cursor stops advancing).
[Required (public write; only with explicit approval)] [Step]: Reply using INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_COMMENT_REPLIES (post reply text to the chosen parent comment identifier; one call per reply).

[Optional (to avoid duplicates and/or verify)] [Next Step]: Fetch thread replies using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_COMMENT_REPLIES (skip if an equivalent reply exists; after posting, confirm the new reply appears).

[Fallback (if comment retrieval fails or is unexpectedly empty)] [Fallback]: Re-check using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA and, if needed, re-discover a different media item via INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA before retrying INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS.
known_pitfalls: [INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_COMMENT_REPLIES] Requires a parent comment identifier; using a media identifier can fail or attach to the wrong object.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS] Results are commonly nested under data.data; mis-parsing can look like an empty response.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA] Pagination may include paging.next; continue with paging.cursors.after (and items under data.data) rather than reusing a next URL.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA] Invalid/inaccessible media may raise API error code 100 / subcode 33; validate before retrying comment reads.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS] Auth/connection failures can surface as OAuthException code 190 (401) or “no active connection”; re-auth/connect out-of-band then retry.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Helper to consistently extract nested list payloads from tool responses.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Instagram is a social media platform for sharing photos, videos, and stories. Only supports Instagram Business and Creator accounts, not Instagram Personal accounts.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=instagram. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="instagram") to create a connection BEFORE executing any instagram tools.

INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA.description: Get Instagram user's media collection (posts, photos, videos, reels, carousels). Use when you need to retrieve all media published by an Instagram Business or Creator account with support for pagination and time-based filtering.

after.description: Cursor for forward pagination - retrieve media after this cursor Value comes from paging.cursors.after in the response; stopping at the first page silently omits older posts.

limit.description: Number of media items to return per page (default: 25, max: 100)

since.description: Unix timestamp - filter results to media created after this time. If both 'since' and 'until' are provided, 'since' must be less than 'until'.

until.description: Unix timestamp - filter results to media created before this time. If both 'since' and 'until' are provided, 'since' must be less than 'until'.

before.description: Cursor for backward pagination - retrieve media before this cursor

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Available fields: id, caption, media_type, media_url, permalink, thumbnail_url, timestamp, username, comments_count, like_count, legacy_instagram_media_id, is_comment_enabled, owner, shortcode, media_product_type, alt_text, is_ai_generated, is_shared_to_feed, media_audio_type, view_count, reposts_count, saved_count, shares_count, total_like_count, total_comments_count, total_views_count, children{media_url,media_type,thumbnail_url} Reels appear as media_type=VIDEO and media_product_type=REELS; filter both fields to identify reels. media_url is a direct file URL; permalink is the user-facing share link. Optional fields like caption and like_count may be null or absent in the response.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator Account ID. Use 'me' for the authenticated user, or provide the numeric IG User ID obtained from the Instagram Graph API (typically 17 digits, e.g., '17841405793187218'). Facebook Page IDs are not supported or automatically converted.

graph_api_version.description: Instagram Graph API version to use (e.g., 'v21.0')

auto_resolve_fb_page_id.description: Deprecated no-op retained for backwards compatibility. On Instagram Login the host follows the token (graph.instagram.com) and Facebook Page IDs are not resolved. Provide an Instagram Business or Creator Account ID directly (or 'me').

INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS.description: Tool to retrieve comments on an Instagram media object. Use when you need to fetch comments from a specific Instagram post, photo, video, or carousel owned by the connected Business/Creator account. Supports cursor-based pagination for navigating through large comment lists. An empty data array in the response indicates the post has no comments and is not an error. Bulk-fetching across many media objects may trigger API rate limits.

after.description: Cursor for forward pagination. Use the cursor value from previous response's paging.cursors.after field

limit.description: Number of comments to return per page (typically 50-100)

before.description: Cursor for backward pagination. Use the cursor value from previous response's paging.cursors.before field

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve for each comment. Available fields: id, text, username, timestamp, like_count, replies, from, hidden, media, parent_id, user

ig_media_id.description: The ID of the Instagram media object (post/photo/video/album) to retrieve comments from. Must be a Media ID, not a User ID. Media IDs can be obtained from endpoints like GET /ig-user-id/media. Media IDs typically look like '17858625294504375'. The media must belong to the connected Business/Creator account; media from other accounts will return empty data or an error.

graph_api_version.description: Instagram Graph API version to use

INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_COMMENT_REPLIES.description: Tool to create a reply to an Instagram comment. Use when you need to reply to a specific comment on an Instagram post owned by a Business or Creator account. The reply must be 300 characters or less, contain at most 4 hashtags and 1 URL, and cannot consist entirely of capital letters.

examples: This is a test reply via Instagram Graph API
message.description: The text content of the reply to be posted. Maximum length: 300 characters. Maximum 4 hashtags allowed. Maximum 1 URL allowed. Cannot consist entirely of capital letters.

ig_comment_id.description: The unique identifier of the Instagram comment to which you want to reply. This is the ID of the parent comment that will receive the reply.

graph_api_version.description: Instagram Graph API version to use. Defaults to v21.0.

INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA.description: Get a published Instagram Media object (photo, video, story, reel, or carousel). Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific Instagram post including engagement metrics, caption, media URLs, and metadata. NOTE: This action is for published media only. For unpublished container IDs (from INSTAGRAM_CREATE_MEDIA_CONTAINER), use INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS to check status instead.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Supported: id, caption, comments_count, is_comment_enabled, like_count, media_type, media_url, media_product_type, legacy_instagram_media_id, owner, permalink, shortcode, thumbnail_url, timestamp, username, alt_text, is_ai_generated, is_shared_to_feed, media_audio_type, view_count, reposts_count, saved_count, shares_count, total_like_count, total_comments_count, total_views_count, children, comments. For nested fields use 'children{media_url,media_type}'. UNSUPPORTED (cause errors): tagged_users, user_tags, location, filter_name, latitude, longitude, text — use 'caption' not 'text'. For insights metrics use INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS. Tagged-media retrieval is unavailable through this Instagram Login toolkit. A MediaBuilder error means the ID is an unpublished container — use INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS.

ig_media_id.description: The numeric ID of the Instagram media object from the Graph API (e.g., '17858625294504375'). IMPORTANT: This must be a numeric string, NOT an alphanumeric shortcode from instagram.com/p/<shortcode>/ URLs (e.g., 'DUTi4n4D9wg' is NOT valid). Obtain numeric IDs from INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA or similar endpoints. For unpublished container IDs, use INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS instead.

graph_api_version.description: Instagram Graph API version to use
